resources.string: Choose a tool from the list below to get started

Finds games that span more than one disc and writes an .m3u playlist for each, so your frontend lists the game once and can swap discs. For ES-DE, the discs also move into a folder that appears as a single game.
Search the built-in PS Vita title list and save a .psvita or .dpt shortcut for a game installed in Vita3K, so your frontend can list and launch it.
Downloads the latest community custom systems for ES-DE on Android, points each one at its ROM folder, and installs them into ES-DE\'s custom_systems folder. Restart ES-DE to load them.
Decompresses Switch .nsz files back into full .nsp packages for emulators that can\'t read NSZ. Needs your own prod.keys. Your .nsz files are kept.
Zips each cartridge ROM (Game Boy, GBA, DS, NES, SNES, N64, Genesis and more) into its own .zip to save space. Most emulators open the zip directly. The unzipped ROM is removed.
Compresses PS1, PS2, PS3, PSP, Saturn, Dreamcast and Sega CD disc images (.cue/.bin, .gdi, .iso) into one .chd file per game. Lossless, so games play the same in less space.
Compresses GameCube and Wii .iso files to .rvz, Dolphin\'s lossless format. Games play the same and take far less space. Your .iso files are kept.
Compresses decrypted 3DS games (.3ds, .cci) to .zcci, which Azahar plays directly. Encrypted dumps can\'t be converted. Your original files are kept.
Strips the unused video partition and padding from Redump Xbox .iso files. The trimmed XISO replaces the original and runs in xemu and Hakux.
Applies an IPS, UPS, or BPS patch to a ROM, such as a translation, romhack, or bug fix, and saves the patched copy in the same folder as the ROM. The original ROM is left as it is.
